subject._excluded_criminal: Criminal subject matter is out of scope. federal-criminal, criminal-public-corruption and habeas-post-conviction were removed on 15 September 2026. The reader is a civil defendant newly served and not yet represented, and selection among criminal outcomes on a page carrying an attorney-advertising banner reads as a verdict on the judge however factually each line is written. The line is subject matter, not docket type, so collateral post-conviction proceedings are excluded although they carry civil docket numbers. scripts/validate.mjs enforces this and also fails any cr docket. procedural.privilege-crime-fraud is the crime-fraud exception to attorney-client privilege, a civil discovery doctrine, and stays.

rules.procedural_tags: as many as the document genuinely decides

search_terms.trade-secrets: "trade secret" OR "Defend Trade Secrets Act" OR "misappropriation of trade secrets"
search_terms.trademark-unfair-competition: "Lanham Act" OR "likelihood of confusion" OR "unfair competition" OR "trademark infringement"
search_terms.commercial-contract: "breach of contract" OR "breach of the implied covenant" OR "commercial contract"
search_terms.business-torts: "tortious interference" OR "breach of fiduciary duty" OR "unjust enrichment"
search_terms.closely-held-fiduciary: "oppressed minority" OR "minority shareholder" OR "LLC operating agreement" OR "member oppression"
search_terms.franchise-distribution: "New Jersey Franchise Practices Act" OR "franchise agreement" OR "distributorship"
search_terms.consumer-fraud: "Consumer Fraud Act" OR "ascertainable loss" OR "consumer fraud"
search_terms.employment: "Title VII" OR "New Jersey Law Against Discrimination" OR "wrongful termination"
search_terms.insurance-coverage: "duty to defend" OR "insurance coverage" OR "declaratory judgment" AND policy
search_terms.data-privacy-cybersecurity: "data breach" OR "Video Privacy Protection Act" OR "personally identifiable information"
